Class PropertyContainer

java.lang.Object
nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.core.structures.properties.PropertyContainer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<PropertyValuePair<?>>, IPropertyContainerConst, IPropertyHolder, IPropertyHolderConst
@NotThreadSafe public final class PropertyContainer extends Object implements IPropertyHolder, IPropertyContainerConst
Manages the properties of a structure.

New instances of this class can be created using forType(StructureType).

A property container is created for a specific structure type. It contains all properties that are defined for that type as defined by StructureType.getProperties().

It is not possible to set a property that is not defined for the structure type this property container was created for. Attempting to do so will result in an IllegalArgumentException.

  • Constructor Details

    • PropertyContainer

      public PropertyContainer()
      Creates a new empty property container.

      It is generally recommended to use forType(StructureType) instead to create a property container with the default properties for a specific structure type. This ensures that the required properties for that structure type are correctly marked as required and have their default values set.

    • canRemoveProperty

      public boolean canRemoveProperty(Property<?> property)
      Description copied from interface: IPropertyHolder
      Checks if a property can be removed from this property holder.

      A property can not be removed under the following conditions:

      • The property is required (e.g. defined by StructureType.getProperties()).
      • The property does not exist in this property holder.
      Specified by:
      canRemoveProperty in interface IPropertyHolder
      Parameters:
      property - The property to check.
      Returns:
      true if the property can be removed from this property holder, false otherwise.

      public static PropertyContainer ofAll(Object... properties)
      Creates a new PropertyContainer from the given properties.

      A new PropertyContainer with the given properties.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the properties are not provided in pairs of 3.
